author: claude
summary: Backend half of moving tone/timbre/pace off voice-level VoiceAttributes to per-variant SpeakerProfile settings (owner-requested): these describe how a specific recording performs, which can differ between two variants of the same voice, unlike class/gender/age which stay voice-level. Mirrors the exact pattern performance_tags already established.

files.change: Added tone/timbre/pace to the settings-write allowlist alongside engine/test_text/performance_tags.

get_speaker_settings() now defaults tone/timbre to [] and pace to '' alongside performance_tags. update_speaker_settings() applies the same INV-TAG-1 whitespace normalization (collapse runs to a single dash) to tone/timbre as performance_tags, since the frontend now edits all three through the same TagAutocompleteInput.tsx component.
list_speaker_profiles() now includes tone/timbre/pace per profile, read from spk_settings, alongside performance_tags.
Added tone?/timbre?/pace? to SpeakerProfile (per-variant, mirrors backend).

Added a per-variant performance-attrs row: TagAutocompleteInput for tone/timbre (suggestions from taxonomy.ts getSection), SearchableSelect for pace -- each writes through handleSavePerformanceAttr() to POST /api/speaker-profiles/{name}/settings with just that one key, same one-key-at-a-time pattern as the existing performance_tags handler.

Removed pace from oneFields and tone/timbre from manyFields (moved to per-variant). handleArchetypePick() now only applies class/gender/age from an archetype pick -- tone/timbre/pace are no longer part of this voice-level editor, so archetype-driven values for those fields are dropped rather than written to a hidden, no-longer-displayed part of VoiceAttributes.

flow_impact: Both backend and frontend halves landed in this change. tone/timbre/pace are now edited exclusively per-variant (VariantEditor.tsx); OverviewTab.tsx's voice-level editor no longer surfaces them. VoiceAttributes (frontend type) and the voice-level DB model still declare tone/timbre/pace fields for schema compatibility, but nothing writes to them anymore from the UI.
